subfiles.title: List of papers on expelled Japanese correspondents in Turkey
subfiles.about: An index sheet records three diplomatic telegrams concerning the expulsion of Japanese news correspondents from Turkey and Istanbul.
subfiles.summary: Lists telegrams: Honaker's and Kelley's November reports on Eti Moto's expulsion for photographing military zones, and a January Domei-correspondent expulsion.

interest: Tracks Turkey's wartime expulsions of Japanese press correspondents.
